history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration ensure better anticipation and mitigation by peacekeeping missions of the risks associated with a withdrawal.
history.administration_response: The Administration underlined that missions implemented their own enterprise risk management process (including a risk registry and risk treatment plans) and that mission plans were also expected to include a risk analysis section. To support missions in anticipating and mitigating the risks associated with a withdrawal, in February 2024 the Department of Peace Operations initiated the development of military exit concepts of operation anticipating potential force withdrawal scenarios for all relevant peacekeeping operations. A first exit concept of operations was developed in April 2024, and five others are being developed and are expected to be delivered by the end of January 2025. The Department will then assess which of the five remaining missions (of which three are within the scope of volume II) will also require a contingency exit concept of operations. In addition, the risks associated with withdrawal are assessed by missions and integrated into risk registers (e.g., MONUSCO), internal planning and strategic processes. The Department of Management Strategy, Policy and Compliance has conducted site visits to UNSOM and MONUSCO and discussed the risks associated with withdrawal extensively with senior management of those missions.
history.board_assessment: The Board notes the progress made on this issue and will consider the recommendation closed when all the relevant exit concepts of operations are issued and when risks associated with withdrawal are systematically included in the missions’ risk registers.

history.sg_progress: Peacekeeping operations are required to develop comprehensive mission plans outlining key deliverables related to transition and withdrawal processes. These plans include a dedicated section on risk analysis so as to ensure thorough planning for and mitigation of potential challenges. In addition, the Business Transformation and Accountability Division conducted site visits in 2024 to two peacekeeping missions – MONUSCO and UNSOS. The risks associated with withdrawal were discussed with the risk owners, the local enterprise risk management committees and the special representatives of the Secretary-General. The Administration considers this recommendation to have been implemented and requests its closure by the Board.

history.administration_response: The Administration respectfully requests closure of this recommendation, given that it was implemented. history.board_assessment: The documents provided show improved inclusion of risk anticipation and mitigation in the context of withdrawal preparation. The recommendation is therefore considered implemented.
